description_en: Synchronously modifies the whitelists of the context service (Service) and Dashboard
description_zh: 同步修改上下文服务 Service 和 Dashboard 白名单
name: ModifyContext0SecurityIps

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IP addresses in the whitelist group. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 白名单分组里的IP列表，多个IP白名单间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en: The name of the whitelist group for the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例的白名单分组名称
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The modification mode of the whitelist. Valid values:

0: overwrites the whitelist group.
1: adds a whitelist group.
2: deletes a whitelist group
parameters.help_zh:
白名单修改模式，取值范围如下：

0：覆盖修改白名单分组；
1：新增白名单分组；
2：删除白名单分组
parameters.name: modify_mode
